caption: The drawing depicts a lace bonnet with elaborate detailing. The bonnet consists of a light gray or off-white lace material that is intricately patterned with repetitive, delicate designs. At the top of the bonnet, there are three prominent decorative elements made from a gathered or ruffled fabric colored deep purple. Two wide purple ribbons extend from either side of the bonnet, hanging down and bordered by a lattice-like lace strip that also features the purple color woven into it. The composition centers the bonnet vertically on a plain, lightly shaded background. The artist's signature, "Frank J. Nelson," appears near the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Straw Bonnet
